Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.
spellEffects: 'Aoe'; effectRadius: 210; targeting: 'Location'; affects: 'Enemies'; cooldown {values: [7,7,7,7,7], affectedByCdr: false}; rechargeRate: [7,7,7,7,7]

There is no limit as to how many Dark Spheres can be active at a time. After Syndra gains the Transcendent bonus, the number of Dark Sphere charges available is represented by small Sphere icons under her health bar.
Passive: Dark Sphere's cooldown is reduced equivalent to an amount of ability haste. — Ability Haste 10 / 20 / 30

sources_quoted.quote: With c_i the effective cooldown of ability i, the cast epochs of a solo ability are 0, c_i, 2c_i, ... a deterministic renewal schedule; the shared-timeline version is the superposition with mutual-exclusion, resolved greedily by cast order ... a cast counts when it *starts* within the window.

independent_computation.step_1_does_a_Q2_instance_exist: Yes. The cached wiki text for Dark Sphere carries a Transcendent Bonus that stocks a second Dark Sphere charge at 40 Splinters of Wrath (max 2), and the ability notes confirm the charge pips exist in game. A second, separately castable Dark Sphere is therefore a real mechanic, not an invented slot. The cache-side audit records (batch-6, batch-e9-1) independently confirm 'Q2' is the modeled name for exactly that second charge.
independent_computation.step_2_does_it_belong_in_an_AOE_rotation: Yes. Dark Sphere is flagged spellEffects='Aoe' with effectRadius 210, 'dealing magic damage to nearby enemies', and the notes state there is no limit to how many spheres can be active. The second charge carries the identical AoE payload (230 + 70% AP at rank 5). Any AoE rotation that lists Q but omits Q2 drops a full Dark Sphere's worth of AoE damage, so '<absent>' cannot be right for a Syndra AoE rotation in which the second charge is available.

step_3_is_the_magnitude_5_consistent.reading_A_position_in_the_derived_cast_o: Syndra has exactly five castable damaging slots (Q, Q2, W, E, R; P Transcendent is a buff, not a cast). A 1-based order position for a Q2 appended to the derived AoE order is 5 = last of five. Consistent, and matches the scenario family name 'derived_order'.
step_3_is_the_magnitude_5_consistent.reading_B_cast_count_in_the_fight_window: math-foundations gives cast epochs 0, c, 2c, ... within the window with c = cd x 100/(100+AH). Dark Sphere base cd = 7 s; R's passive explicitly feeds Dark Sphere 10/20/30 ability haste (rank 3 = 30), and a level-18 coupled loadout adds item haste. At a combined ~40 AH, c = 7 x 100/140 = 5.0 s, giving cast starts at 0, 5, 10, 15, 20 -> 5 casts in a ~20-25 s window. With no haste at all (the cache marks Q affectedByCdr=false), c = 7 s gives 5 casts for a window in [28, 35) s. 5 is therefore an attainable, in-range cast count for Dark Sphere under the documented schedule.
step_3_is_the_magnitude_5_consistent.reading_C_targets_hit_in_the_AOE_branch: Dark Sphere has no target cap in the cached text, so against a full five-champion enemy roster the AoE instance hits 5. Consistent.

independent_computation.step_4_conclusion: Every reading of the leaf that the permitted sources admit (order position, cast count, AoE targets) makes 5 an admissible value, while '<absent>' is admissible only under one narrow condition (the scenario running the splinters option below 40, so the second charge is not stocked). Nothing in the permitted evidence indicates that condition. The diff direction (a modeled, wiki-sourced second Dark Sphere charge appearing in Syndra's AoE rotation) is correct and the magnitude is in range.

residual_uncertainty: The golden snapshot's leaf schema (order position vs. cast count vs. targets hit) lives in scripts/golden_snapshot.py, which runbook R-18/R-19 forbids reading, so the exact unit of '5' could not be pinned. The verdict rests on 5 being admissible under every reading the permitted sources allow, plus the mechanic itself being wiki-confirmed.

Splinters gate: the scenario's splinters option is defined in src/ and could not be read. If 'syndra_derived_order_39' runs splinters < 40, Syndra has one Dark Sphere charge and the Q2 leaf should stay absent — that is the single condition that would flip this verdict to old_value_correct.

Charge-throughput caveat (cast-count reading only): the wiki charge system stocks at most 2 Dark Spheres and regenerates 1 per 7 s recharge, so total Dark Spheres over a window T is ~2 + floor(T / c), NOT 2 x (Q's own cast count). If the sibling leaf /fights/manual_target/rotation/aoe/Q both reads 5 under a cast-count encoding, the pair implies 10 spheres over the window and would over-count sustained Dark Sphere throughput. The sibling leaf lives in scripts/golden_baseline.json (forbidden), so this could not be checked; flagged for the orchestrator to verify.
